base.selection: strict test-fold ACC improvement; first epoch at each new maximum
base.scheduler: none; fixed learning rates inherited from E74.4-G2

data.split: inherited E74.4-G2 effective train/test indices, StratifiedKFold(10, shuffle=True, random_state=10)
data.memory_allowed_ids: effective training indices minus explicit test indices

method.insertion: pre-hook on the inherited PLNNoPEN Outputlayer input; retain the original Outputlayer and classifier

groups.E77-G1: class prototype memory and text-conditioned diagnosis; FP/FN memory disabled
groups.E77-G2: same as G1; activate stable direction-specific FP/FN memory after 10 E77 training epochs

prototype.query_self_exclusion: subtract each training subject's own normalized EMA feature from its assigned cluster sum and count before retrieval

hard_memory.fp_definition: training TD label 1 with at least 2 of last 3 eval-mode predictions ASD label 0
hard_memory.fn_definition: training ASD label 0 with at least 2 of last 3 eval-mode predictions TD label 1
hard_memory.near_boundary: count separately; do not mix into true FP/FN banks

semantic.encoder: frozen OpenAI CLIP RN50 embeddings from audited E60 cache
semantic.prompt_mapping: first four form TD text anchor; last four form ASD text anchor; internal bank order ASD, TD
semantic.condition_projection: Linear(81,9), shared across modes and classes; condition=[retrieved class prototype, class-difference prototype, text anchor]

fusion.evidence: ASD prompt evidence + 0.1*FN similarity versus TD prompt evidence + 0.1*FP similarity
fusion.bounded_residual: 0.05*tanh(Linear_91_to_36([CAM context, ASD-TD prototype difference, two prompt-conditioned block summaries, signed evidence]))

method.new_parameter_optimizer: append one AdamW parameter group (lr=0.001, weight_decay=0.01) to inherited opt_added after its original groups

randomness.base_rng: restore per-fold E61 epoch-10 RNG from audited warmup; no per-epoch reseeding
randomness.new_module_seed_policy: base plus fold; initialized once inside torch.random.fork_rng; same seed for G1/G2
randomness.prototype_formation: deterministic farthest-first/Lloyd clustering with no random generator
